newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices shed recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices shed recent gains.

text.p: Copper prices eased in Bombay on Tuesday, losing recently gained ground, dealers said.
Other base metals held their ground and stayed in narrow trading bands.
Copper fell by 50 rupees to 13,050 rupees per quintal on demand resistance from the industrial buyers at improved level while weak trend in the world market prompted light profit-taking, dealer said.
Meanwhile nickel was steady at the improved level of 37,200 rupees per quintal amid nearby shortage and stray physical support.

Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees per quintal as were zinc at 6,900 rupees, and lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading. Tin was available at an unchanged price of 34,400 rupees per quintal but volume was at low ebb.
